title: Alisson wants to sign new Liverpool contract
description: Liverpool goalkeeper Alisson Becker wants to stay at the club beyond the end of the season, when his current contract is set to expire.

title: Struggling Sunderland beat Chelsea to move off bottom of Premier League
description: Sunderland held on to their first Premier League win since August as Enzo le Fee's penalty help the hosts sink Chelsea at the Stadium of Light.

title: Brighton breeze past 10-man Brentford to move up to second
description: Diego Gomez's long-range strike fires Brighton to a 2-0 over Brentford, who saw Igor Thiago be shown a straight red card, as Fabian Hurzeler's side move up to second in the Premier League.

title: Friedel group completes Shrewsbury Town takeover
description: Shrewsbury Town's American takeover deal is done, allowing owner Roland Wycherley to retire, reports BBC Radio Shropshire.

title: A shock departure and key results - inside Wrexham's seismic week
description: BBC Sport Wales addresses the key changes made at Wrexham in what was a seismic week for the Championship club as CEO Michael Williamson departed.

title: London City thump Birmingham to close gap on second
description: London City Lionesses defeat Birmingham City 4-1 to move to within four points of second-placed Chelsea in the WSL.

title: What new Kane deal means for England and the Premier League record
description: Harry Kane's new deal at Bayern Munich may end his Premier League career but offers fresh hope he can lead England to glory, writes Phil McNulty.

title: All done deals from September-November 2026
description: Check out the significant signings and departures in the Premier League, Scottish Premiership, EFL and Women's Super League.

title: Were any current Man City players signed during charges period?
description: BBC Sport's Ask Me Anything team looks at whether any Manchester City players were signed during the time the club have been found guilty of breaching the Premier League's financial rules.

title: Arsenal had more than 20 players on shortlist to capitalise on title win
description: Senior football correspondent Sami Mokbel goes inside Arsenal's bid to capitalise on their Premier League title and strengthen their squad this summer.

title: Life as a Wag in the transfer window
description: What is life like for footballers' families during the transfer window where a last-minute deal means you need to uproot your life and move hundreds of miles?
